北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京风大天冷，记得多穿衣物，小心着凉哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is cold and windy. Dress warmly to avoid catching a cold!
北京.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃ | 💨 北风警报：西北风 6级

宁波.name: 宁波
宁波.ai_briefing_zh: 宁波大雾锁城，湿度很高，注意出行安全。
宁波.ai_briefing_en: Ningbo is very foggy and humid. Please take care when traveling.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海小雨淅沥，体感微凉，出门记得带伞，别淋湿。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai has light rain. It feels cool, so take an umbrella!
上海.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州多云温暖，湿度很高，注意保持室内通风。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is warm and cloudy with high humidity. Keep your home ventilated.
广州.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阳光正好，温暖湿润，户外活动要补水哦。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny, warm, and humid. Remember to hydrate during outdoor activities.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州小雨降温又刮风，外出记得带伞，注意保暖。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou has rain and wind with a temperature drop. Bring an umbrella and stay warm.
杭州.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃ | 💨 北风警报：西北风 4级

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京有雾，能见度低，驾车出行请注意安全。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is foggy with low visibility. Drive safely if you're out and about.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天微凉，风力较小，体感舒适，记得添衣。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast and cool with no wind. It feels pleasant, but dress accordingly.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉大雾弥漫，湿度爆表。出行注意交通安全。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is very foggy with extreme humidity. Be careful on the roads!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安天晴但很冷，早晚温差大，注意加衣保暖。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny but very cold. Big temperature swings, so dress warmly.
西安.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆小雨绵绵，体感湿凉，出门别忘带伞哦。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing has light rain, feeling damp and cool. Don't forget your umbrella!
重庆.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨有霾且极寒，请务必穿暖戴好，注意防护。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is hazy and extremely cold. Dress warmly, protect yourself!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳阴冷，体感偏低，记得多穿保暖衣物哦。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is overcast and very cold. Remember to layer up and stay warm!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天湿冷，体感偏凉，多穿衣物避免着凉。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is overcast and damp-cold. Dress warmly to avoid catching a cold.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门有雾，能见度低，驾车出行请注意安全。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is foggy with low visibility. Drive safely if you're out and about.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛小雨伴大风，体感寒冷，请务必多加保暖！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao has light rain and strong winds. It feels very cold, so stay warm!
青岛.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃ | 💨 北风警报：西北风 6级

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连阴天湿冷，体感偏低，记得添衣保暖哦。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is overcast and damp-cold. It feels chilly, so remember to layer up.

漳浦.name: 漳浦
漳浦.ai_briefing_zh: 漳浦大雾弥漫，湿度非常高，注意交通安全。
漳浦.ai_briefing_en: Zhangpu is very foggy with extreme humidity. Be careful on the roads!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天湿润，体感稍凉，出门记得带件外套。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is overcast and humid. It feels a bit cool, so bring a jacket.
